correctness.rationale: For the simplicial-poset moment-angle cellular cochains, support A is preserved by the differential and Hochster identifies the support-|A|=k summand with reduced cohomology of injective words shifted by k+1. Shellability concentrates it in degree 2k, with dimension d_k. For a permutation stabilizing A, each fixed length-j word must use j individually fixed labels and its odd-dimensional T-coordinate factors contribute sign(g|A). The Euler-Poincare signed cochain trace is (-1)^k sign(g|A) sum_j (-1)^j (f_A)_j. Comparing with the injective-word top-homology character yields sign_k tensor D_k and induction over supports. The S_n-invariant multiplicity equals the sign multiplicity of D_k: for j<=k-2, the sign average of fixed ordered j-tuples vanishes; for j=k-1,k the averages are both 1 and coefficients cancel. Thus reduced rational cohomology of the orbit quotient vanishes, with finite-group rational transfer. Independently summed the derived character over S_n for 2<=n<=5; all positive-degree invariant sums were zero and n=2 transposition has trace -1. The finite check corroborates, but does not prove, the all-n argument.
